description: List business categories with their slugs, optionally only those matching `search` (for example "plumb") or under one `parent`. Use the slug in search_businesses, count_businesses and request_quotes. Free.

limit.description: How many categories (default 25; at most 25 are shown in the text).

parent.description: Only the sub-categories of this parent category slug.

search.description: Only categories whose name contains this text, for example "plumb".

name: list_categories
title: List categories
